description.zh: 要查询的防护对象组名称。您可以设置该参数，模糊查询已创建的防护对象组名称。
description.en: The name of the protected object group that you want to query. Fuzzy query is supported.

description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)接口查看当前WAF实例ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

description.zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为**1**，表示返回第 1 页数据。
description.en: The page number of the paginated results. Default value: **1**, which indicates the first page.

description.zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为**20**，表示每页包含 20 条结果。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default value: **20**, which indicates 20 entries per page.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: regions outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

title.zh: 查询防护对象组名称列表
